main_text.p: de auro Philosophorum ex inferioribus metallis parādo expresse& solidè confirmemus, adducemus testimonia evidentia Philosophorum complurium. Ac primo quidem Basilius in manuscripta declaratione manualis suæ Practicæ, de Tinctura Solis in hæc verba scribens:Debes igitur scire (inqt) quod Lapis noster componatur ex suapropr) essentia & alia metalla transmutet in aurum verum: quod Aurum (addit) ITERUM DESTRUI OPORTET & in meliorem Lapidem converti. Satis evidenter hic (opinor) indicat prius construendum esse hoc aurum, quàm iterum destrui possit, vel in meliorem converti lapidē: unde & in Rhyhtmis suis Germanicè impressis, statim ab initio canit:

page.notes: The scan is slightly blurred; some words in the italic passage (e.g. "propria") are uncertain. Right-hand edge shows show-through from the facing page, not transcribed. A faint word in the lower margin is unreadable and omitted.
